mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal is a whole fresh apple, a minimally processed fruit with fiber and naturally occurring carbohydrates that generally has a moderate effect on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes. It is generally a suitable option, and pairing it with a protein or fat source can further moderate glycemic response; if needed, choose whole fruit instead of juice or other lower-fiber fruit products.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A single whole red apple served raw.
